name: check-runs-cost
assumptions: The smoke run is priced on decision sheet item 1's recommended M1, openrouter/openai/gpt-5.6-terra (item 1 is still open; another M1 scales with its catalogue prices); the B1 reference run on the paper's backbone for the reference numbers it is held to, openrouter/openai/gpt-5.4.

A C2 to C5 session costs what research/results/h1-cost.json measured for its condition and item kind on the pinned full set (GateMem) or the case set (MEM-INV-Bench), low and high; the smoke run's fixture items are priced at the full set's mean, not at their own sizes.

A C1 session is one answer call: its own long-context prompt in characters over four, plus the framing the fixture C1 cassettes hold beyond their prompts, and the fixture C1 answer's output tokens; the high estimate scales both by H1's token scale (4/3). C1 makes no read, so H1's extra read turns do not apply.
The judge, GPT-4o through OpenRouter, runs one (low) to three (high) attempts per GateMem session, each at H1's measured judge prompt and verdict size.
Reasoning tokens per answer call, the note's output limit, the token scale and every other estimate setting are H1's (research/results/h1-cost.json estimates).
No prompt caching, batch discount or provider minimum; list prices from pi-ai 1.3.0's catalogue, not a quote. The configs' spend_ceiling_usd bounds what a run can spend, per provider.
